structure.unit: Uniform Fiduciary Income And Principal Act

text.section:
A unitrust policy may:
Provide methods and standards for: a. Determining the timing of distributions; b. Making distributions in cash or in kind or partly in cash and partly in kind; or c. Correcting an underpayment or overpayment to a beneficiary based on the unitrust amount if there is an error in calculating the unitrust amount;
Specify sources and the order of sources, including categories of income for federal income tax purposes, from which distributions of a unitrust amount are paid; or
Provide other standards and rules the fiduciary determines serve the interests of the beneficiaries.
